title.zh: 为指定的资源列表统一创建并绑定标签
title.en: Create and attach tags to a specified list of resources uniformly

descriptions.zh: 绑定标签前，阿里云会校验资源已有标签数量。超过限制值后返回报错信息。
descriptions.en: Alibaba Cloud checks the number of existing tags on the resource before attaching a new tag. If the limit is exceeded, an error message is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paistudio tag-resources --resource-type ResourceGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id rgqssemfn6vjqqev --tag Value=value Key=key --api-version 2022-01-12 --region cn-hangzhou
